subject: Request: onboarding without PO — evidence checklist & approval path
messages:
From: Elisa Gomez <elisa@papertraillabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding request: Papertrail pilot (no PO possible?)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to get Papertrail set up for a short pilot (3 months, ~USD 12k). Our procurement process typically only issues POs for vendor invoices > $15k, so Procurement asked us to check if Redwood will accept invoice-only onboarding for this pilot (no PO).

Attached is our standard onboarding form and a draft SOW. Can you share what evidence Redwood needs to grant a temporary no-PO onboarding path and who signs off internally? We need to get internal approval by Friday to hit our go-live target.

Best,
Elisa Gomez
Head of Partnerships, Papertrail Labs

Attachments: papertrail_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), signed-sow-draft.docx (DOCX)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elisa Gomez <elisa@papertraillabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding request: Papertrail pilot (no PO possible?)

Elisa — thanks for the fast turnaround and attaching the SOW. I’m looping in Marissa (sales ops) and Vanessa (vendor intake) — they’ll confirm what evidence Procurement/Finance needs for a temporary invoice-only onboarding.

High level: Papertrail is a small pilot, ~12k, below Redwood’s default PO threshold. We’ve approved similar exceptions for strategic pilots before but need Finance sign-off and a limited-term clause (30–90 days) to limit vendor exposure.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you confirm the checklist and whether we need an LOE or alternative ID proof?
- Vanessa: please run the vendor intake and flag any red flags (tax forms, insurance).
- Elisa: if Procurement can provide a written internal approval (email) that will speed Finance review.

I’ll coordinate approvals on our side — aiming to respond by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding request: Papertrail pilot (no PO possible?) — checklist

Thanks Jonas — quick checklist below. Per Procurement guidance (see attached matrix), smaller pilots can be accepted invoice-only with manager + finance approval and a short-term agreement.

Required evidence for invoice-only onboarding (pilot < $15k):
- Completed onboarding_form (we have it)
- Proof of authorized purchaser from Papertrail (signed approval email from their Procurement)
- W9 or equivalent tax form
- Basic insurer confirmation (if required by category) — if not available, a short risk acceptance note from Legal
- Signed SOW or MSA stub (we have draft; need counter-signed)

Additional notes:
- Finance needs a confirmation email from Papertrail’s buyer certifying the $12k engagement and that they will not request a PO for pilot invoices.
- Finance prefers the invoice cadence be monthly and for Redwood to put a 90-day invoice hold clause in the SOW.

I attached po_threshold_matrix.xlsx for reference. Monica from Finance, can you confirm the approval path and whether you’ll sign off here? If Finance approves, I’ll route to Procurement for a temporary waiver record.

—Marissa
Sr. Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: po_threshold_matrix.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding request: Papertrail pilot (no PO possible?) — finance input

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the matrix. From Finance side: we can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for this pilot under the following constraints:

1) Total contract value must remain <= $15,000 (confirmed).
2) Papertrail must provide a written, date-stamped approval from their internal Procurement/Buyer stating they will accept invoice-only billing for this engagement.

3) Payment cadence: monthly invoices only. Invoices to be sent to AP@redwood.ai with PO field left blank and reference: PTL-PILOT-07-2027.

4) Risk mitigations: attach the draft SOW with a 90-day invoice hold clause and a 30-day termination right for Redwood for non-payment. If Insurance details are missing, Legal will issue a short acceptance memo.

Evelyn — please confirm you’re OK to sign the waiver record once Papertrail’s approval email is received. I’ll log the exception in the procurement waiver tracker (PROC-918).

If all good, Marissa can send the formal approval path back to Elisa so they can obtain the internal buyer sign-off.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Finance — Revenue Operations
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding request: Papertrail pilot (no PO possible?) — waiver approval ready to sign

All — I reviewed the materials (onboarding form + draft SOW). Assuming Papertrail sends the buyer approval email and W9, Finance signs the temporary waiver record in Procurement and will sign off on invoice-only onboarding for this pilot (CV <= $15k).

I’ll prepare the waiver record and add the following line item: "Pilot invoice-only exception valid for 90 days from onboarding date; Finance requires monthly invoice cadence and invoice reference code."

Jonas — once you get Elisa’s buyer confirmation, forward it to me and I’ll execute.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Finance

Subject: Re: Onboarding request: Papertrail pilot (no PO possible?) — next steps

Elisa — thanks. Good news: Finance has pre-approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots <= $15k provided your Procurement buyer sends a short written confirmation and the W9. Evelyn will sign the waiver once we have those.

To keep this moving: could you please ask your buyer to reply to this thread with a short note like: "Papertrail Procurement confirms buyer approval to accept invoice-only billing for the 3-month pilot (USD 12,000)." If you can attach the W9 in that reply, we can finalize within 24 hours.

I’ve attached the SOW draft with the suggested invoice hold clause and the PO reference string to use on invoices: PTL-PILOT-07-2027.

Once we have the buyer email and W9, Monica/Evelyn will log the waiver and sign off. We’ll then proceed with vendor intake (Vanessa) and vendor onboarding will be scheduled.

Best,
Jonas
VP, Strategic Accounts
